critical_code_review_comments: Android targetSdk=35: on Android 15+ devices edge-to-edge is enforced, so android:statusBarColor/navigationBarColor are ignored. The bars will show whatever the WebView draws behind them. The page background is #09090B, so it should still look dark. env(safe-area-inset-top) may be 0 on older Android WebViews, so content could slide under the status bar. Consider Capacitor's android.adjustMarginsForEdgeToEdge ('force' or 'auto') or @capacitor/status-bar if users report overlap on Android 15.

capacitor.config.json has a plugins.SplashScreen block (backgroundColor #781b3a), but @capacitor/splash-screen is not installed (packageClassList only lists PushNotificationsPlugin), so that config does nothing. The native launch screen and splash drawable decide the splash look.
Info.plist UIRequiredDeviceCapabilities=armv7 comes from the Capacitor template. It is harmless, but arm64 is the more accurate value for iOS 14+.
